issues.explanation: Chapter 50 explicitly assigns Xiahou Dun to defend Xiangyang, but Chapter 51 has Cao Ren flee to and apparently rely on Xiangyang without explaining Xiahou Dun's status. This makes the defense command and Cao Ren's retreat inconsistent.
issues.suggested_fix: Clarify that Cao Ren retreats to Xiangyang under Xiahou Dun's command, or revise Chapter 50 so Cao Ren is assigned to Xiangyang and Xiahou Dun elsewhere.
